title: Make source trade document generation atomic against duplicate requests and source invalidation
description: Stage3 core business workflow integrity. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Introduce compatible deterministic source-row and document-generation key locking and transaction before authoritative source reread, duplicate detection, number reservation, header and line construction. Cover sales-order and loading-list generation with source cancellation/edit/delete and concurrent identical requests. Keep existing source permission and doc-center live customer authority; shared loading participant scope must remain valid. Do not infer historical ownership from free-text RefNo/SalesOrderNo or add schema. Preserve existing duplicate conflict semantics and existing document-copy behavior; same source/type generates at most one complete set, unrelated sources remain usable.

Use existing transaction ownership and lock order compatible with ERP395 header/item locks and sales/loading cancellation. Recheck source status/customer/quantity/amount/unit under locks, preserve immutable line snapshots; failed type/line/permission/DB write rolls back headers/lines/number evidence together. Two independent SQL connection duplicate generate, source cancel/edit versus generate, number collision and multi-type failure tests, existing generation/print/unit regressions and safe Release. Browser evidence or accurate blocker.

implementation_evidence: TradeDocumentGeneration.GenerateAsync checks FindExistingAsync and unique document numbers and builds source snapshots before its transaction; source controller generation loads source before generation. Concurrent equivalent requests or cancellation/edit can race these reads despite ERP394 target permission and ERP395 parent mutation locks.
